title: Exclude unused legacy MIDI program slots from export rejection
scope: Do not block GP8 export because an unreferenced legacy channel-table slot contains program -1; continue rejecting invalid programs selected by a track.
acceptance: Reproduce fade-to-black.gp4 and pinned guitarpro3/beat-harmonics.gp3. The negative-program slots are unreferenced by tracks; prove reference selection explicitly in the regression.
Export must not reject either fixture solely for an unused program -1. Any other export failure must remain separately identified rather than masked or waived.
Selecting one of those invalid slots from a track must still produce a precise rejection. Cover an authored invalid value other than -1 and an out-of-range channel reference.

Do not mutate the source channel table, silently coerce negative programs to zero, or relax format-independent validation indiscriminately. Test preflight/export agreement and selected program retention through the independent consumer.
exclusions: No referenced-unbound default-instrument normalization is authorized by this slice. A referenced sentinel needs a separately justified contract.

reproduction.instructions: Reproduce fade-to-black.gp4 and pinned guitarpro3/beat-harmonics.gp3. The negative-program slots are unreferenced by tracks; prove reference selection explicitly in the regression. See the linked investigation decision and review receipt for the confirmed baseline.

evidence.detail: Public contract; linked matrix cases are in obligation.
Existing scoped evidence; not proof of all AlphaTab variants.
Validates instrument range only through valid track channel references while retaining table-wide bank and mixer checks.
Binary pitched-track channel selection retains the authored program; percussion selection keeps its established program-zero normalization.
Covers both named fixtures, explicit unused-slot selection proof, selected -7 and 128 values, invalid references, strict preflight/export agreement, reimport, and nonmutation.
Direct binary channel-reference bytes prove that a selected pitched channel retains authored program -7.
Pinned AlphaTab verifies that selected non-default program 73 survives GP8 export.

implementation-ready: Public-API inspection confirmed every -1 slot in both fixtures is unused, including channels 25/41/57 and 9/25/41/57. ValidateSong currently checks the entire table before target export.

resolution: Made MIDI program validation reference-aware without changing table-wide bank or mixer validation. Unused legacy channel-table sentinels remain authored values and no longer block GP8 export, while selected negative or overflowing programs remain track-located rejections. Binary pitched-track channel selection no longer coerces a selected negative program; percussion normalization is unchanged.
